restaurants.name: The Dome
restaurants.description: Fine‑dining mix of traditional Pakistani, continental and Chinese dishes, offering a premium fine‑dining experience with scenic hill‑top views and curated cuisine.
restaurants.special_thing: Scenic hill‑top views and premium fine‑dining experience

restaurants.name: El Momento Steakhouse
restaurants.location: Beverly Centre, F‑6/1 Blue Area, Islamabad
restaurants.description: Luxury steakhouse offering premium imported cuts such as Wagyu, rib‑eye, and filet mignon, complemented by a full bar and upscale ambience. Marketed as Islamabad’s premier steakhouse with a reputation for excellent service.
restaurants.special_thing: Islamabad’s premier steakhouse with high‑quality imported cuts

restaurants.name: Em En Caffè
restaurants.description: Fine‑dining café offering a seasonal, chef‑driven menu that blends European and Asian influences.
restaurants.special_thing: Elegant ambience, chef‑driven menu and warm, attentive service

restaurants.name: Mastara – Rooftop Restaurant
restaurants.description: Rooftop dining with panoramic city views; live BBQ station, multi‑cuisine menu (Pakistani, grills, continental). Promoted as a rooftop destination with over 200 signature dishes and a reputation for unforgettable views and lively atmosphere.
restaurants.special_thing: Panoramic city views and live BBQ station with over 200 signature dishes

restaurants.name: Umami
restaurants.location: 4th Floor, Pakland Tower 3, New Blue Area
restaurants.description: Global fine‑dining concept offering sushi, Japanese, Italian, continental, gourmet fast‑food, and desserts; noted for its fully electric kitchen, diverse global menu, and family‑friendly upscale setting, frequently cited as one of Islamabad’s top fine‑dining spots.
